items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Chase had a band. The drummer Bibbs . . . Lazard was the drummer. Bibbs Lazard. He was the drummer.

ctx.x: Chase had a band. The drummer Bibbs . . .

Lazard, no, Lazard. Lazard was the drummer. Bibbs Lazard. He was the drummer. Great young drummer. Great. But he just simmered down, just phased out. He was a cousin. Way back, my grandfather and Manny Perez were interrelated. You heard of Manny Perez?
